checks: The real live bridge posts an isolated irregular eighteen-cell final snapshot and leaves the main board, hand and public/private state untouched while work is pending
The actual generated worker policy returns the same legal faction-finishing decision without running the main-thread policy
The production worker message path reports a matching request and a real action
Successive decisions reuse one worker and immediately release its temporary script URL
Retry/exit terminates the worker and resolves its pending turn without placing or trading
Changing matches cancels the old owner before creating the next worker
A late recommendation cannot act after a winner has been locked
A forged or stale illegal placement is rejected and replanned against the live board
A failed worker uses the existing yielding fallback and is not recreated repeatedly within that match
Browsers without workers retain a legal main-thread fallback
scope: Actual worker builder/source, live bridge, isolated policy execution, action validation, URL cleanup, worker reuse, match/winner cancellation and unsupported/error fallbacks. VM-backed worker transport, no browser scheduling or device frame-rate claim.
